headline: A big first down for the Colts
what_happened: The Indianapolis quarterback threw a short pass to J.Downs, who gained enough yards for a first down to keep their drive alive.
who: D.Jones threw the ball to J.Downs while being defended by N.Williams.
why_it_matters: This was bad news for the Chiefs because it gives the Colts a fresh set of four tries to move down the field, increasing their chances of winning by 9 percent.
